title: ESQL: CCE in IndexResolver between InvalidMappedField and UnsupportedEsField

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

body:
### Description

For certain mappings the following query:
```
POST _query?error_trace
{
  “query”: “”"
  from * [metadata _index] | limit 10000
  “”"
}
```

triggers a CCE:
```
{ "error": {
    "root_cause": [
      {
        "type": "class_cast_exception",
        "reason": "class org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.UnsupportedEsField cannot be cast to class org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.InvalidMappedField (org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.UnsupportedEsField and org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.InvalidMappedField are in unnamed module of loader java.net.FactoryURLClassLoader @6eb5b9e7)",
        "stack_trace": """org.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchException$1: class org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.UnsupportedEsField cannot be cast to class org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.InvalidMappedField (org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.UnsupportedEsField and org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.InvalidMappedField are in unnamed module of loader java.net.FactoryURLClassLoader @6eb5b9e7)

Caused by: java.lang.ClassCastException: class org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.UnsupportedEsField cannot be cast to class 
org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.InvalidMappedField (org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.UnsupportedEsField and org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.type.InvalidMappedField are in unnamed module of loader java.net.FactoryURLClassLoader @6eb5b9e7)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.index.IndexResolver.buildIndices(IndexResolver.java:771)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.index.IndexResolver.mergedMappings(IndexResolver.java:466)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.ql.index.IndexResolver.lambda$resolveAsMergedMapping$8(IndexResolver.java:381)
	at org.elasticsearch.server@8.11.0/org.elasticsearch.action.ActionListenerImplementations$ResponseWrappingActionListener.onResponse(ActionListenerImplementations.java:236)
	... 21 more
```
